The Thyrocare Jaanch Tumour Marker Panel for males is designed to detect and monitor cancer-specific markers that are commonly associated with male health. This package includes tests for Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP), Beta-Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (β-hCG), Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA). 2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Jaanch Tumour Marker Panel (Male)?
This test package is recommended for men over 40, individuals with a family history of cancer, or those who have been advised to monitor cancer-related biomarkers. 3. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare tumour marker test?
No fasting is required for this test. The Thyrocare Jaanch Tumour Marker Panel (Male) is designed for convenience, allowing you to take the test at any time of day. The test parameters are unaffected by recent food or beverage intake, which makes it easier to schedule without preparation.
4. How is the sample collected and processed by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare provides a free home sample collection facility across India. After booking your test, a trained phlebotomist will visit your home to collect the blood sample under sterile conditions. The sample is then sent to Thyrocare’s state-of-the-art diagnostic center, where fully automated machines ensure rapid, high-precision testing of tumour markers.

The Thyrocare Jaanch Tumour Marker Panel (Male) is priced at RS 1,799. This cost includes all 7 tumour marker tests, home sample collection, and delivery of a digital report via SMS and email. It is an affordable solution for men seeking reliable and preventive cancer screening.

By offering NABL and ISO-accredited lab facilities, nationwide home collection, and cutting-edge automated testing systems, Thyrocare ensures speed, safety, and accuracy in every test. The Jaanch Tumour Marker Panel (Male) is a carefully curated package to help detect possible cancer risks and support proactive men’s health screening.
